EEGLAB-FUNC-001.title: EEGLAB exposes user-facing pop_ functions and lower-level signal-processing functions.
EEGLAB-FUNC-001.requirement: Map MCP tools to EEGLAB-style user operations and record underlying function families when possible.

EEGLAB-STRUCT-001.title: EEG datasets carry event, urevent, channel, history, and metadata structures.
EEGLAB-STRUCT-001.requirement: Inspect and report EEG.event, EEG.urevent, channel locations, and EEG.history before scientific interpretation.

EEGLAB-EVENT-001.title: Event semantics must be validated before event-locked analysis.
EEGLAB-EVENT-001.requirement: Only confirmed task-condition triggers should drive epoching; boundary/QC/segment markers are not ERP triggers.

EEGLAB-FILT-001.title: Filtering changes the data and must be parameterized and reported.
EEGLAB-FILT-001.requirement: Record cutoffs, rationale, and derivative-output strategy for filtering.

EEGLAB-ASR-001.title: clean_rawdata provides ASR and bad-channel/bad-segment cleaning.
EEGLAB-ASR-001.requirement: Use clean_rawdata only when the plugin is available and thresholds/data-shape assumptions are recorded.

EEGLAB-ICA-001.title: ICA workflows require appropriate data preparation and rank/reference awareness.
EEGLAB-ICA-001.requirement: Check continuous-data suitability, bad-channel policy, and rank/reference decisions before ICA.

EEGLAB-ICLABEL-001.title: ICLabel classifies ICA components after ICA decomposition.
EEGLAB-ICLABEL-001.requirement: Require ICA weights and ICLabel availability before automated component classification.

EEGLAB-TF-001.title: Time-frequency decomposition depends on event locking, baseline, cycles, and frequency settings.
EEGLAB-TF-001.requirement: Report event-locking, baseline, cycles, frequency range, and output limitations for ERSP/ITC.

EEGLAB-DIPFIT-001.title: DIPFIT source localization requires channel locations, model assumptions, and source resources.
EEGLAB-DIPFIT-001.requirement: Require ICA/source model, channel locations, DIPFIT resources, and head model/template assumptions.

EEGLAB-BIDS-001.title: EEGLAB supports BIDS import and STUDY workflows for group analysis.
EEGLAB-BIDS-001.requirement: Require BIDS/multi-subject structure, sidecar metadata, design variables, and locked single-subject preprocessing before BIDS/STUDY or group-statistics claims.

EEGLAB-BIDSEXPORT-001.title: EEG-BIDS export requires complete metadata and derivative provenance.
EEGLAB-BIDSEXPORT-001.requirement: Treat BIDS export as guidance-only unless EEG-BIDS export support, sidecars, channel/electrode metadata, event descriptions, and derivative provenance are complete.

BIDS-EEG-001.title: BIDS EEG sidecars preserve acquisition, channel, electrode, and coordinate-system metadata.
BIDS-EEG-001.requirement: Record task, sampling, reference, power-line frequency, recording type, channel status, electrode positions, and coordinate-system metadata when treating data as BIDS-ready.

BIDS-EVENTS-001.title: BIDS events.tsv files use onset/duration timing and events.json sidecars for column meanings.
BIDS-EVENTS-001.requirement: Require onset and duration columns, and describe trial_type/additional event columns in events.json before inferring task-condition semantics.

EEGLAB-COURSE-001.title: EEGLAB course materials cover advanced BIDS, preprocessing, source/connectivity, ICA clustering, and statistics.
EEGLAB-COURSE-001.requirement: Use staged project planning and explicit reporting for complex research workflows.

EEGLAB-IMPORT-001.title: EEGLAB import tutorials cover continuous, epoched, event, channel, and BIDS inputs.
EEGLAB-IMPORT-001.requirement: Preserve source path, file format, sidecar availability, events, and channel-location assumptions after import.

EEGLAB-IMPORT-PLUGINS-001.title: EEGLAB imports non-native EEG formats through plugin- or function-dependent paths.
EEGLAB-IMPORT-PLUGINS-001.requirement: Record source format, importer/plugin path, event/channel mapping, and raw-file preservation before treating imported data as analysis-ready.

EEGLAB-EXPORT-001.title: EEGLAB export workflows are format-dependent and must preserve derivative provenance.
EEGLAB-EXPORT-001.requirement: Treat non-.set export as guidance-only unless the target format, plugin/function path, metadata completeness, and derivative output are explicit.

EEGLAB-HED-001.title: HEDTools supports HED event annotation workflows for EEGLAB data.
EEGLAB-HED-001.requirement: Use HED as structured event metadata only when tags/schema/version or equivalent event descriptions are recorded.

EEGLAB-HISTORY-001.title: EEGLAB history can be used to recover GUI operations into reproducible scripts.
EEGLAB-HISTORY-001.requirement: Review EEG.history-derived scripts, parameterize paths/outputs, and record deviations before treating them as batch protocols.

EEGLAB-EVENTSCRIPT-001.title: EEGLAB event-processing scripts can modify event labels, latencies, and selections.
EEGLAB-EVENTSCRIPT-001.requirement: Record event modification rules, latency units, urevent preservation/relinking, and semantic validation before event-script changes support analysis.

EEGLAB-MFF-001.title: MFF-matlab-io is an official EEGLAB plugin path for EGI MFF import/export.
EEGLAB-MFF-001.requirement: Treat MFF import/export as plugin-dependent and report event/channel metadata mapping and derivative output status.

EEGLAB-NWB-001.title: NWB-io is an official EEGLAB plugin path for NWB import/export guidance.
EEGLAB-NWB-001.requirement: Treat NWB exchange as plugin-dependent guidance unless importer/exporter availability and metadata mapping are explicit.

EEGLAB-BVA-001.title: BVA-io is an official EEGLAB plugin path for BrainVision import/export.
EEGLAB-BVA-001.requirement: Treat BrainVision import/export as plugin-dependent and preserve marker/channel/header provenance.

EEGLAB-CHANLOC-001.title: Channel locations are required for topographic and source-level interpretation.
EEGLAB-CHANLOC-001.requirement: Check channel-location coverage before topography, interpolation, source localization, or montage-dependent claims.

EEGLAB-REREF-001.title: Rereferencing changes the signal and affects rank/reference interpretation.
EEGLAB-REREF-001.requirement: Record reference choice and rank/reference implications before rereferencing or ICA interpretation.

EEGLAB-RESAMPLE-001.title: Resampling changes sampling rate and must preserve analysis-relevant frequency content.
EEGLAB-RESAMPLE-001.requirement: Record target sampling rate and justify it relative to the frequency content needed for analysis.

EEGLAB-LINE-001.title: Line-noise handling should be explicit and plugin-dependent when CleanLine/Zapline-style tools are used.
EEGLAB-LINE-001.requirement: Record power-line frequency, method, parameters, and plugin availability for line-noise cleanup.

EEGLAB-REJECT-001.title: Artifact and epoch rejection require explicit thresholds, review policy, and retained-data reporting.
EEGLAB-REJECT-001.requirement: Record rejection criteria and retained/rejected data before interpreting cleaned or epoched results.

EEGLAB-EPOCH-001.title: Extracting epochs depends on valid event codes, time windows, and baseline assumptions.
EEGLAB-EPOCH-001.requirement: Report event labels, epoch windows, baseline windows, and trial counts after epoch extraction.

EEGLAB-ERP-001.title: ERP averaging and plotting require validated epochs, channel/ROI choices, and condition definitions.
EEGLAB-ERP-001.requirement: Report condition definitions, channels/ROIs, time windows, and rejected-trial context for ERP outputs.

EEGLAB-SPECTRAL-001.title: Spectral analyses require explicit channels, frequency ranges, and data-shape assumptions.
EEGLAB-SPECTRAL-001.requirement: Record channel/ROI set, frequency range, data shape, artifact policy, and interpretation limits for spectra/connectivity.

EEGLAB-TOPO-001.title: Topographic maps require channel locations and valid time/frequency selections.
EEGLAB-TOPO-001.requirement: Require channel-location coverage before topographic plots or scalp-map interpretation.

EEGLAB-STUDY-001.title: STUDY creation, design, precomputation, visualization, clustering, and statistics are separate group-analysis stages.
EEGLAB-STUDY-001.requirement: Lock single-subject preprocessing, subject/session metadata, design variables, measure type, precomputation state, alpha, and correction before group claims.

EEGLAB-STUDY-PRECOMP-001.title: STUDY measures must be precomputed before group visualization, clustering, or statistics.
EEGLAB-STUDY-PRECOMP-001.requirement: Require a STUDY design, selected measure family, precomputation parameters, and saved derivatives before claiming group-level measures.

EEGLAB-ICCLUSTER-001.title: STUDY ICA clustering depends on ICA decompositions, measures, clustering features, and review.
EEGLAB-ICCLUSTER-001.requirement: Treat ICA clustering as guidance-only unless ICA, channel/source assumptions, clustering features, outlier policy, and review criteria are explicit.

EEGLAB-LIMO-001.title: LIMO is an EEGLAB plugin path for GLM/statistical EEG workflows.
EEGLAB-LIMO-001.requirement: Treat LIMO as guidance-only unless plugin availability, design matrix, first/second-level model, and correction policy are explicit.

EEGLAB-SIFT-001.title: SIFT covers source information flow/connectivity workflows with model-fitting and validation requirements.
EEGLAB-SIFT-001.requirement: Treat SIFT as guidance-only unless plugin availability, stationarity/model order, validation, and statistics are explicit.

EEGLAB-PLUGIN-001.title: EEGLAB plugin workflows must be checked before plugin-dependent claims or execution.
EEGLAB-PLUGIN-001.requirement: Probe plugin/function availability and report support level before plugin-dependent workflows.

EEGLAB-PLUGIN-DEV-001.title: EEGLAB plugin tutorials explain how to write functions, GUIs, and eegplugin_ extensions.
EEGLAB-PLUGIN-DEV-001.requirement: Use the plugin tutorial and extension pages to scope new EEGLAB extensions, but do not treat them as executable analysis workflows.

EEGLAB-RELICA-001.title: RELICA estimates the reliability of ICA decompositions and can optionally run on NSG.
EEGLAB-RELICA-001.requirement: Treat RELICA as an ICA-reliability planning workflow that depends on an existing ICA decomposition and bootstrap settings.

EEGLAB-VIEWPROPS-001.title: Viewprops extends pop_prop for component and channel inspection with ICLabel-aware display.
EEGLAB-VIEWPROPS-001.requirement: Use Viewprops as a review and visualization aid after ICA, not as a substitute for ICA or component review.

EEGLAB-GETCHANLOCS-001.title: get_chanlocs digitizes 3-D head images into EEG.chanlocs for plotting and source localization.
EEGLAB-GETCHANLOCS-001.requirement: Use get_chanlocs when 3-D head images and fiducials exist and the goal is to populate or repair channel locations.

EEGLAB-ROICONNECT-001.title: ROIconnect performs source-level ROI connectivity analysis with atlas-defined regions.
EEGLAB-ROICONNECT-001.requirement: Use ROIconnect only when a source model, ROI atlas, and connectivity metric are defined.

EEGLAB-EEGSTATS-001.title: EEGstats computes band power, alpha peak frequency, and alpha asymmetry for EEGLAB datasets and STUDYs.
EEGLAB-EEGSTATS-001.requirement: Use EEGstats when frequency-band definitions, channel selections, and dataset or STUDY scope are recorded.

EEGLAB-AMICA-001.title: AMICA is an advanced ICA plugin path with separate installation and reporting requirements.
EEGLAB-AMICA-001.requirement: Treat AMICA as indexed guidance unless plugin availability, algorithm choice, rank/PCA settings, compute strategy, and reproducible output paths are explicit.

EEGLAB-NSG-001.title: NSGportal enables remote/HPC EEGLAB workflows outside local-first execution.
EEGLAB-NSG-001.requirement: Treat NSG remote execution as out of the local MCP execution surface unless credentials, upload policy, remote job provenance, and a dedicated integration are explicit.

EEGLAB-PIPELINE-001.title: EEGLAB automated pipelines bundle import, cleaning, ICA/ICLabel, epoching, and reporting choices.
EEGLAB-PIPELINE-001.requirement: Use one-click/batch pipelines only after defaults, outputs, events, and plugin prerequisites are accepted and recorded.

requirements.text: Confirmed task-condition/trigger events are required for epoching.
Boundary, impedance, excluded, or segment-only markers must not be used as ERP triggers.
Epoch and baseline windows should be recorded.

not_recommended: Do not epoch around boundary, impedance, excluded, or segment-only markers.

requirements.text: ERSP/ITC needs confirmed event locking or a justified continuous-data design.
Baseline settings must be specified and recorded.
Frequency range and cycles/wavelet settings should be recorded.

not_recommended: Do not report ERSP/ITC effects without event/baseline/frequency settings.

requirements.text: clean_rawdata/ASR should operate on continuous data unless a justified exception is recorded.
clean_rawdata plugin/function must be available.
ASR/bad-channel thresholds must be recorded.
Cleaned output must be treated as a derivative, not a raw overwrite.

not_recommended: Do not apply ASR to epoched-only data without explicit override and rationale.

requirements.text: ICA normally requires suitable continuous data or a justified design.
Rank/reference decisions must be reviewed before ICA.
Bad-channel handling policy must be defined before ICA.

not_recommended: Do not run ICA casually on epoched-only data or after unresolved rank/reference changes.

requirements.text: ICA weights must exist before ICLabel classification.
ICLabel plugin/function must be available.

not_recommended: Do not interpret ICLabel probabilities as automatic removal decisions without review.

requirements.text: ICA weights must exist before component removal.
Components must be reviewed or explicit thresholds recorded before removal.
Component-removed output must be saved as a derivative.

not_recommended: Do not auto-remove components without threshold/rationale reporting.

requirements.text: ICA/source components or an explicit source model must exist.
Channel locations must be complete and appropriate.
DIPFIT resources must be available.
Head model/template assumptions must be defined.

not_recommended: Do not make anatomical certainty claims from missing montage/model prerequisites.

requirements.text: BIDS import requires a BIDS root, sidecars, or an explicit BIDS metadata path.
EEG-BIDS/pop_importbids must be available before BIDS import.
events.tsv onset and duration columns should be confirmed before treating imported events as BIDS-valid.

not_recommended: Do not treat a BIDS import as analysis-ready until acquisition, event, and sidecar metadata gates are also reviewed.

requirements.text: STUDY creation requires multi-subject datasets or a BIDS/STUDY project structure.
Single-subject preprocessing protocol should be locked before treating the STUDY as statistics-ready.

not_recommended: Do not treat STUDY creation as approval for group statistics; design and statistics gates remain separate.

requirements.text: STUDY design requires multi-subject or BIDS/STUDY organization.
Design variables and levels must be defined before creating a STUDY design.
Single-subject preprocessing protocol should be locked before design-level interpretation.

not_recommended: Do not interpret a design until subject/session metadata and preprocessing assumptions are documented.

requirements.text: STUDY/group analysis needs multi-subject or BIDS/STUDY organization.
Single-subject preprocessing protocol must be locked before group statistics.
Design variables and levels must be defined.
The STUDY measure/precomputed measure family must be recorded before statistics.
Alpha and multiple-comparison correction policy must be recorded before group statistics.

not_recommended: Do not run group statistics before design variables and preprocessing assumptions are locked.

requirements.text: STUDY precompute requires a multi-subject/BIDS STUDY project.
STUDY design variables should be known before precomputing group measures.
Single-subject preprocessing protocol must be locked before group measure precompute.
Precomputed STUDY measure family and parameters must be recorded.
Precomputed measure outputs must be stored as derivatives.

not_recommended: Do not interpret STUDY plots or statistics until the relevant measures have been precomputed and recorded.

requirements.text: ICA clustering is a STUDY/group workflow and requires multi-subject organization.
Subject-level ICA decompositions must exist before ICA clustering.
Clustering measure/feature family must be recorded.
Clustering features, distance metric, cluster count/algorithm, and outlier policy must be recorded.
Cluster/component review criteria should be documented before interpretation.

not_recommended: Do not treat ICA clusters as anatomical sources without source/head-model assumptions and review.

requirements.text: STUDY/group analysis needs multi-subject or BIDS/STUDY organization.
Single-subject preprocessing protocol must be locked before group statistics.
Design variables and levels must be defined.

not_recommended: Do not run group statistics before design variables and preprocessing assumptions are locked.

requirements.text: Raw input must be preserved before destructive preprocessing.
Derivative output path/strategy must be planned.
Processing parameters should be recorded in the report/protocol.

not_recommended: Do not overwrite raw data after filtering/resampling/rereferencing/rejection.

requirements.text: Original EEG recordings and source sidecars must be preserved read-only.
Destructive processing must write to a derivative output path.
Reference, ground, montage, or cap layout must be recorded or explicitly marked missing.
Power-line frequency must be recorded before line-noise, filtering, or analysis-ready claims.
Hardware/software acquisition filter notes must be recorded or explicitly marked unavailable.
Task description and acquisition system should be recorded for reproducibility.
Impedance or channel-quality notes should be recorded when available.

not_recommended: Do not claim a dataset is analysis-ready when acquisition reference, line frequency, acquisition filters, or raw/derivative policy are unknown.

requirements.text: BIDS/HED metadata work requires a BIDS path, events sidecars, HED tags, or an explicit event-code map.
BIDS EEG metadata should include *_eeg.json, *_channels.tsv, *_electrodes.tsv, and *_coordsystem.json or equivalent explicit provenance.
BIDS events.tsv must include onset and duration columns for event timing.
Condition/event semantics must be described by events.json, HED, or a validated lab codebook.
trial_type and additional events.tsv columns must have events.json descriptions before condition-level interpretation.

not_recommended: Do not infer condition semantics from events.tsv labels alone when sidecar descriptions are missing.

requirements.text: EEG-BIDS export functions must be available before BIDS export claims.
BIDS export needs complete EEG/channel/electrode/coordinate metadata or documented equivalents.
Exported events must have onset and duration timing.
Event columns need events.json, HED, or codebook descriptions before BIDS export claims.
BIDS export output must be a separate derivative/export directory.
EEGLAB, plugin, and processing version/provenance should be recorded for exported derivatives.

not_recommended: Do not claim BIDS export support through this MCP without a dedicated export tool; keep it to planning/reporting unless implemented.

requirements.text: The source file format and importer path must be recorded before import-readiness claims.
The plugin/function needed for the requested non-native import format must be available.
Event and channel/header mapping assumptions must be recorded after plugin-dependent import.
Original files and sidecars must be preserved before import conversion or cleanup.

not_recommended: Do not treat plugin-imported event/channel metadata as validated until the mapping is reviewed.

requirements.text: The requested export format must be supported by built-in EEGLAB save or an available plugin/function.
Exported data must be written as a derivative, not over raw inputs.
Channel, event, header, and sidecar metadata needed by the target format must be complete or explicitly limited.
EEGLAB, exporter/plugin, and processing version/provenance should be recorded for exported derivatives.

not_recommended: Do not claim non-.set export support through this MCP unless a dedicated export workflow and validation are added.

requirements.text: Event labels/columns must be described by HED, events.json, or a validated codebook.
HED schema/version or equivalent event-codebook provenance must be recorded.
Condition-code mapping should be validated before event-locked interpretation.

not_recommended: Do not treat HED tags as confirmed ERP triggers until condition semantics are validated.

requirements.text: EEG.history or equivalent current-session processing history must be available.
History-derived scripts must be reviewed for paths, dataset state, parameters, and outputs.
Script parameters should be explicit rather than hidden in GUI defaults.
Batch scripts should write derivative outputs rather than overwrite raw inputs.

not_recommended: Do not run copied GUI history as a batch protocol before reviewing paths, defaults, and output policy.

requirements.text: Event recoding, deletion, or latency-shift rules must be recorded before scripted event changes.
Event latency units and sampling-rate assumptions must be recorded before scripted latency edits.
urevent links must be preserved, relinked, or explicitly reported as a limitation.
Modified event meanings should be documented by HED, events.json, behavioral logs, or a lab codebook.

not_recommended: Do not use scripted event modifications to create condition triggers without a validated codebook or behavioral log.

requirements.text: Channel-location metadata must be available or a concrete montage repair/interpolation plan must be supplied.
Channel-location file, rename map, interpolation method, and excluded channels should be recorded.

not_recommended: Do not interpret scalp maps, interpolation quality, or source locations without usable channel coordinates.

requirements.text: Line-noise frequency, method, and affected harmonics/windows must be recorded.
Line-noise-cleaned output must be treated as a derivative.

not_recommended: Do not apply 50/60 Hz cleanup without confirming the local mains frequency and reporting the method.

requirements.text: Spectral analysis requires an explicit frequency range or band definition.
Artifact handling and data-shape suitability must be documented before spectral interpretation.
Channels or ROIs should be recorded for spectra/band-power summaries.

not_recommended: Do not make resting-state claims from epoched-only derivatives unless the design explicitly supports it.

requirements.text: Connectivity requires an explicit frequency range and method.
Artifact policy and channel/ROI selection must be documented before connectivity interpretation.
Sensor/source space, causality limits, and model assumptions should be reported.

not_recommended: Do not interpret sensor-level connectivity as anatomical connectivity without source/model validation.

requirements.text: Topographic maps require usable channel locations.
Topographic time/frequency window and plotting parameters should be recorded.

not_recommended: Do not produce or interpret scalp maps when channel locations are missing or incomplete.

requirements.text: LIMO workflows require LIMO plugin availability.
First-level/second-level model, design variables, and contrasts must be defined.
Correction and alpha policy must be recorded before LIMO statistical claims.

not_recommended: Do not claim LIMO support from the MCP unless plugin availability and a dedicated model/reporting protocol are confirmed.

requirements.text: AMICA plugin/functions must be available before AMICA-specific ICA claims.
AMICA should be planned on suitable continuous data unless a justified design is recorded.
Rank, PCA, and reference choices must be reviewed before AMICA.
AMICA compute strategy, output directory, and reproducibility settings must be recorded.
AMICA outputs must be written to a derivative directory.

not_recommended: Do not route AMICA execution through generic ICA tools unless an AMICA-specific workflow and eval coverage are added.

requirements.text: SIFT workflows require SIFT/groupSIFT plugin availability.
MVAR/source connectivity requires model order, stationarity, and validation reporting.
SIFT statistics and multiple-comparison policy should be recorded.

not_recommended: Do not run or claim SIFT connectivity support through this MCP without a dedicated SIFT execution workflow.

requirements.text: NSGportal plugin/functions must be available for NSG planning.
User approval, credentials policy, and data-upload policy must be explicit before remote compute.
Remote job parameters, upload/download paths, and reproducibility records must be planned.

not_recommended: Do not execute remote NSG jobs through this local MCP unless a dedicated secure integration is implemented.

requirements.text: The plugin goal, target user operation, and intended EEGLAB integration point must be defined.
The intended pop_/eeg_/low-level function family and GUI/command-line boundary must be recorded.
A plugin validation, sample-data, and documentation plan should be recorded before claiming research support.

not_recommended: Do not treat plugin authoring guidance as support for executing a new analysis plugin through this MCP.

requirements.text: RELICA plugin/functions must be available before ICA reliability claims.
A subject-level ICA decomposition must exist before RELICA reliability review.
Bootstrap/resampling settings, number of decompositions, and compute strategy must be recorded.
Components and reliability summaries should be reviewed before interpretation.

not_recommended: Do not claim RELICA reliability support unless plugin availability, ICA state, and bootstrap settings are explicit.

requirements.text: Viewprops plugin/functions must be available for Viewprops-specific review claims.
ICA weights must exist before component-property review.
The reviewed component set and classifier/source evidence should be documented.

not_recommended: Do not substitute Viewprops availability for an ICA/ICLabel/component-removal review policy.

requirements.text: get_chanlocs plugin/functions must be available before digitization claims.
3-D head images, electrode photos, or digitization source files must be recorded.
Fiducials and coordinate/reference assumptions must be recorded before channel-location repair claims.
A plan for writing/reviewing EEG.chanlocs should be documented.

not_recommended: Do not claim source/topography readiness from get_chanlocs until channel coordinates are reviewed in EEG.chanlocs.

requirements.text: ROIconnect plugin/functions must be available before ROIconnect-specific claims.
A source model or source-level ROI activity representation must be available.
ROI atlas/parcellation and region selection must be recorded.
Connectivity metric, frequency/time window, and statistical interpretation limits must be recorded.

not_recommended: Do not interpret ROIconnect outputs as anatomical connectivity without source-model, atlas, and statistics validation.

requirements.text: EEGstats plugin/functions must be available before EEGstats-specific claims.
Band definitions, alpha-peak search range, or frequency settings must be recorded.
Channels, ROIs, or STUDY component sets must be recorded for band-power/asymmetry metrics.
Artifact policy and cleaned-data scope should be recorded before interpreting summary metrics.

not_recommended: Do not claim EEGstats results through this MCP unless plugin availability and metric settings are documented.

requirements.text: Raw input must be preserved before pipeline execution.
Pipeline output must go to a derivative directory.
The user must accept bundled defaults before one-click pipeline execution.

not_recommended: Do not use one-click pipelines when the user needs transparent parameter-by-parameter control.

not_for_clinical_use: This document describes research-grade alignment with EEGLAB and SCCN sources. It is not a clinical device, makes no diagnostic claim, and confers no clinical use.
